arguments.script: var scene=UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.CreateScene("Paddle retract audit",new UnityEngine.SceneManagement.CreateSceneParameters(UnityEngine.SceneManagement.LocalPhysicsMode.Physics2D));var physics=scene.GetPhysicsScene2D();var host=new UnityEngine.GameObject("Audit");UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.MoveGameObjectToScene(host,scene);host.SetActive(false);var clone=UnityEngine.Object.Instantiate(UnityEditor.AssetDatabase.LoadAssetAtPath<UnityEngine.GameObject>("Assets/Prefabs/Character.prefab"),host.transform);foreach(var m in clone.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.MonoBehaviour>(true))if(!(m is Character.Control.ArmsSimulation))UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(m);host.SetActive(true);var arms=clone.GetComponentInChildren<Character.Control.ArmsSimulation>();var body=clone.transform.Find("Cauldron").GetComponent<UnityEngine.Rigidbody2D>();body.constraints=UnityEngine.RigidbodyConstraints2D.FreezeAll;foreach(var rb in clone.GetComponentsInChildren<UnityEngine.Rigidbody2D>())rb.gravityScale=0;var slider=clone.GetComponentInChildren<UnityEngine.SliderJoint2D>();void Tick(int n){for(int i=0;i<n;i++){arms.SendMessage("FixedUpdate");physics.Simulate(.02f);if(slider.jointTranslation<slider.limits.min-.01f||slider.jointTranslation>slider.limits.max+.01f)throw new System.Exception("Travel stop exceeded");}}try{foreach(float r in new[]{1.8f,.15f,1.8f,.15f}){arms.ReceiveTarget(body.position+UnityEngine.Vector2.right*r);Tick(250);UnityEngine.Debug.Log("dt="+UnityEngine.Time.fixedDeltaTime+" axis="+slider.transform.right+" tip="+arms.HammerTip.position+" body="+body.position+" limits="+slider.limits.min+","+slider.limits.max+" speed="+slider.jointSpeed);UnityEngine.Debug.Log("requested="+r+" actual="+UnityEngine.Vector2.Distance(body.position,arms.HammerTip.position)+" translation="+slider.jointTranslation+" motor="+slider.motor.motorSpeed+" error="+arms.ExtensionError+" force="+slider.motor.maxMotorTorque);}}finally{UnityEngine.Object.DestroyImmediate(host);UnityEngine.SceneManagement.SceneManager.UnloadSceneAsync(scene);}
arguments.summary: Measure actual paddle extension and retraction in isolated Physics2D
